question: Which of the following statements are CORRECT regarding the universal gravitational force and the gravitational constant Universal gravitational constant.?
explanation:
A) The gravitational force is always attractive between any two masses. This is a fundamental property of gravitation. (Correct)

B) The value of Universal gravitational constant. is a universal constant and does NOT depend on the medium between the interacting bodies. (Incorrect)

C) The gravitational force acts along the line joining the centers of the two masses, hence it is a central force. (Correct)

D) The universal gravitational constant Universal gravitational constant. is a scalar quantity, not a vector quantity. (Incorrect)

Therefore, statements A and C are correct.
